scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix administrador run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:hosting
scripts.deploy:tienda: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:tienda
scripts.deploy:panel: npm --prefix administrador run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:panel
scripts.deploy:api: gcloud run deploy yenyleths-api --source backend --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --max-instances 1
